name: Ananda Sangha Noida
reason: Too thin: a small site whose only offering is the Level 1 Introduction to Kriya Yoga Meditation course (Rs 1500, no date shown); the other events (Diwali, Janmashtami, Yogananda's birth anniversary) are past celebrations. Has an address (E-49, Sector 40), email noida@anandaindia.org and a YouTube channel, so worth a recheck later. Possible future listings: Abhishek Chaturvedi (centre leader).
